title: Effect of atorvastatin gel on clinical parameters and bone histology in alveolar ridge preservation: A randomized clinical trial
authors: Behfarnia P, Hoseini N, Deihimi P, Bayati M, Shatalebi MA. Effect of atorvastatin gel on clinical parameters and bone histology in alveolar ridge preservation: A randomized clinical trial. Dent Res J (Isfahan). 2026 Jan 28;23:4.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collprotect (porcine dermis) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Although 1.2% ATV gel increased lamellar bone formation and reduced dimensional changes in postextraction sockets, the differences were not significant compared with the control group” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
